data.name: Exaggerated Pose
data.description: A masked performer can enhance her own physical and social abilities by simply altering her posture. When she starts this performance, the masked performer chooses a Strength-, Dexterity-, or Charisma-based skill and gains a +%1 competence bonus on checks with that skill as long as she maintains this performance. The masked performer can change the chosen skill as a swift action. Exaggerated pose is an emotion effect and relies on visual components.|ExaggeratedPoseBonus
